title: Onboard cyclone-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description:
Onboard Cyclone-13b v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, GPU/quantized perf profiles, and automated changelog generation. Motivation: Cyclone provides a cost-efficient 13B family we want available in the catalog with validated performance profiles and automated release notes so downstream teams can consume the model with confidence.

What this PR does:
- Adds models/cyclone-13b/v1.0/metadata.json with provenance, config, tokenizer, and recommended runtime flags.
- Adds perf profiles under models/cyclone-13b/v1.0/perf_profiles/: baseline (a100-80gb), p4d-24, and q4_0 / q8_0 quantized CPU/GPU profiles. Profiles include throughput, p95 latency, batchability hints, and memory footprints.
- Wires the new model into the onboarding automation so changelog entries are generated from metadata -> CHANGELOG.md using scripts/generate-changelog.py. The automation includes a template that pulls performance highlights for release notes.
- Adds integration tests tests/model_registry/test_onboard_cyclone.py and unit tests for the changelog generator.
- Updates registry index and model-catalog.json to expose the model in the catalog UI.

Notes and scope:
- Performance numbers were generated on benchmark-lab (see commit notes) and are marked with hardware tags. Numbers are representative; runtime kernel selection may change slightly across regions.
- This PR intentionally does not include a new model weight bundle. Onboarding here is metadata and perf/capability profiling only. Weight ingestion will be a follow-up once licensing is finalized.

Checklist:
- [x] metadata added
- [x] perf profiles added
- [x] changelog automation updated
- [x] tests added and passing
- [x] docs/catalog entry updated

Related Linear: ENG-4921, PM-881.
